interface.name: polly_appearance_v1

description.summary: separate trusted appearance publisher and renderer

interface.description: This private global is restricted to compositor-owned Shell and decorator connections. The Shell publishes themes but cannot render. The decorator renders but can publish only the first theme, before a Shell transaction. Version 4 requires the separately supervised GUI service and geometry schema 4. Earlier private versions are deliberately rejected. Render requests expose caption geometry and text, never client content or input injection.

entry.name: unauthorized
entry.summary: connection does not own this role

request.name: prepare

description.summary: validate a runtime decoration snapshot without applying it

request.description: Configuration contains schema 4, left-controls (0 or 1), and the geometry-only metrics specified by appearance-fields.h. Colors, fonts, glyphs, materials and style selection are interpreted only by the GUI. Unsupported data is rejected through prepared; the Shell keeps the last committed appearance visible. Name is a bounded identifier. Document is a readable, immutable memfd sealed against writes, growth, shrinkage and further seal changes. Its exact size is 1-32768 bytes. Data is owned and validated by the Shell; the compositor does not parse JSON. Passing an FD avoids the connection's small individual-message limit. Only one staged snapshot is kept per resource. Invalid configuration is rejected through prepared, not a fatal protocol error.

request.name: cancel
request.description: Cancellation is idempotent; it never changes the committed appearance.

request.name: submit_frame

description.summary: submit one complete immutable four-strip snapshot

request.description: Metadata and exact dimensions, strides, offsets and size are defined by decoration-frame.h. All strips are supplied in one sealed memfd; there is no partial update. Token, revision, generation, geometry, scale and state must match the latest render request. Old requests are harmlessly rejected. The renderer never receives the application's content.

event.name: frame_result
event.description: Invalid submissions do not alter the currently presented snapshot.

description.summary: discard queued requests for an unmapped, closed or unavailable frame

event.name: renderer_status

description.summary: service health and advisory bootstrap eligibility

event.description: State is 0 disabled, 1 starting or recovering, 2 ready, or 3 failed. Bootstrap eligibility is advisory, is sent only to the decorator, and is checked again on prepare and commit. Any successful theme commit consumes it for the lifetime of this compositor, including reconnects. A Shell prepare takes priority over a staged bootstrap.

interface.name: polly_theme_manager_v1

description.summary: read-only appearance subscription for opt-in applications

interface.description: Public clients may observe the bounded theme document published by the trusted Shell. This interface grants no management or file access. Changes coalesce until the client requests the latest snapshot. Revisions are opaque uint identifiers, not timestamps.

entry.name: unexpected_request
entry.summary: snapshot requested without a change notification

request.name: get_snapshot
request.description: Exactly one request is allowed after changed. The snapshot may be newer than that notification. The unavailable event means that the Shell has not published a runtime theme.
